subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The study of evolution of mankind
solution:
The correct answer is Option no. (3) '**Anthropology'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anthropology** is the study of human societies, cultures, and development.
 
• It includes the study of human evolution, behavior, and physical characteristics. The word is derived from the Greek words** "anthropos" **meaning human and** "logos" **meaning study. - **Anthropology** is a social science that combines elements of biology, history, and sociology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Biology** (Option 1) is the study of living organisms and their interactions with each other and their environment. 
 
• **Anthology** (Option 2) is a collection of literary works, such as poems, stories, or essays.
 
• **Psychology** (Option 4) is the scientific study of human behavior and mental processes.
